protocols.full/g1/d90: Full evaluation: 1 game per rule team and side = 32 matches of 90 s against all 16 rule-based teams (fixed seeds 50001..), plus best-move (greedy) play on every 2nd team, behaviour stats and head to head vs RL Team 4 / RL Team 5 / the start net. About 30-60 min.
protocols.fast/g2/d60: (Off by default since 2026-11-21: fast_rules 1 turns it on.) Fast check: 2 games per team and side against every 3rd rule team (6 teams) = 24 matches of 60 s, plus head to head vs the start net. About 3-5 min. Only comparable with other fast checks.
protocols.ladder/d90: The Elo ladder (lab/ladder.py): every team and net against each other, 90 s matches, every pair from both sides with the same seed; the pairs are chosen to tell the most (close ratings, few games). Elo = Bradley-Terry fit of all results; goals = Poisson attack / defence fit of the same matches. The run's best checkpoint (x_<run>_best) is placed right after the run and keeps playing while the queue is empty.
protocols.estimate/ladder/d90: Estimated Elo during training (lab/ladder.py estimate, the check every fast_every updates, training paused): elo_pairs (12) pairs = 24 matches against placed ladder entries, half spread over the ranking, half near the checkpoint's level; only the checkpoint's rating and goal strengths are fitted, the ladder's held fixed. About ±140 Elo at 95%: a trend line, not a ranking. exp/elo_estimates.jsonl; update 0 = the start net.

rules: Runs are judged by Elo, goals scored and goals conceded (the ladder, protocol ladder/d90); there is no better / worse verdict. Points against the rule bots saturate near 3 and cannot rank good nets.

A run's Elo is the ladder rating of its best checkpoint; it settles as the ladder plays more matches. Two ratings differ when their 95% intervals do not overlap (the intervals are relative to the average rating).
Goals (agf / aga, estimate gf / ga) are opponent-adjusted: per 90 s match against the average ladder entry. Raw goals per match depend on who an entry happened to play.
Estimated Elo during training is for the trend of one run (about ±140); compare runs by their ladder Elo.

Fast checks and full evaluations against the rule bots (fixed seeds) are health checks and the source of behaviour / scouting; never compare numbers of different protocols, and compare them paired. (fixed seeds: same opponents, sides and kickoffs). Sampled play twitches and concedes more than best-move (greedy) play; report both when judging a final team.

elo.definition: ladder rating (ladder/d90) of the run's best checkpoint; lo / hi = 95% interval relative to the average rating

agf.definition: goals scored against the average ladder entry: mean over the entries of exp(mu + att - def_opp) from the ladder's Poisson goal model

aga.definition: goals conceded against the average ladder entry (same model)

elo_estimate.definition: estimated Elo of one checkpoint during training (estimate/ladder/d90): elo, se, lo, hi, gf, ga (adjusted like agf / aga), raw_gf, raw_ga, games, w/d/l, matches

pts.unit: league points per match (win 3, draw 1, loss 0)
pts.definition: mean over the protocol's league matches (rule bots: saturates near 3, a health check)

gd.definition: goals for minus goals against, mean per match

gd_se.definition: standard error of gd (null in old records)

greedy_pts.definition: same league, the net playing its best move instead of sampling (every 2nd team)

h2h.<opponent>.pts.definition: head to head vs another net, both sides; opponents: RL Team 4, RL Team 5, start (the net the run started from)

behaviour.dir_changes_s.unit: direction changes per second per player

behaviour.keeper_dist_px.unit: px from own goal of player slot 0 (not necessarily the de-facto keeper)

train_pts_vs_rules.definition: during training, last 200 matches vs the rule bots, sampled moves, 60% random starting layouts: a trend signal, not an evaluation

compare.pts / compare.gd.definition: difference a - b; paired over identical matches when possible; fixed rule-bot tests only

compare.mde.definition: smallest difference detectable at 5% two-sided with 80% power (2.8 x se of the difference)

cost_hours.definition: train = wall time training, eval = wall time of all evaluations of the run

states.done: trained the full budget, evaluated, best checkpoint placed in the Elo ladder
states.diverged: stopped: training points fell under 70% of the start
states.regressed: stopped: two estimated Elos in a row below the start net's by > 2 se of the difference (before 2026-11-21: two fast checks worse than the start by > 2 se)
states.imported: older run imported from logs (no spec)
